group.passage: Every animal needs rest, but not every animal rests the way people do. Some animals sleep in the water, some sleep in the air, and some even sleep upside down. Below are short notes on six animals and the unusual ways they get their rest.

passage_parts.label: A
passage_parts.title: Sea otters
passage_parts.text: Sea otters often sleep while floating on their backs in the sea, usually in groups. To keep from drifting away while they sleep, they often wrap themselves in kelp, a kind of large seaweed. The kelp holds them in place.

passage_parts.label: B
passage_parts.title: Koalas
passage_parts.text: Koalas eat mostly the leaves of eucalyptus trees. These leaves give them very little energy, and it takes a lot of work for their bodies to break the leaves down. To save energy, koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day, usually high up in a tree.

passage_parts.label: C
passage_parts.title: Dolphins
passage_parts.text: Dolphins live in water, but they breathe air, so they must swim up to the surface again and again. Because of this, a dolphin rests only one side of its brain at a time. The other side stays awake, and the dolphin often keeps one eye open.

passage_parts.label: D
passage_parts.title: Horses
passage_parts.text: Horses can take short, light naps while standing up. Their legs can lock into place, so they do not fall over. However, for the deepest kind of sleep, a horse must lie down. Because other animals hunt horses, a horse lies down only when it feels safe.

passage_parts.label: E
passage_parts.title: Bats
passage_parts.text: Many bats sleep while they hang upside down in a high place. When a bat’s toes lock in place, its own body weight holds it there. This way, the bat can rest for many hours without using much energy.

passage_parts.label: F
passage_parts.title: Frigatebirds
passage_parts.text: Frigatebirds are sea birds that can spend weeks flying over the ocean without landing. Scientists have found that these birds can sleep in the air, sometimes with one side of the brain asleep and the other side awake. While flying, they sleep less than an hour a day. On land, however, they sleep for more than twelve hours a day.

translation_zh.text:
【引言】每種動物都需要休息，但不是每種動物都像人一樣休息。有些動物在水裡睡，有些在空中睡，有些甚至倒掛著睡。以下是六種動物的簡短介紹，以及牠們與眾不同的休息方式。
【A 海獺】海獺常常仰躺著漂浮在海上睡覺，而且通常成群。為了睡覺時不漂走，牠們常用海帶（一種大型海藻）把自己纏起來，海帶會把牠們固定在原地。
【B 無尾熊】無尾熊主要吃尤加利樹的葉子。這些葉子提供的能量非常少，身體也要花很大的力氣才能把葉子分解。為了節省能量，無尾熊一天最多可以睡 20 個小時，通常是待在高高的樹上。
【C 海豚】海豚住在水裡，但牠們呼吸空氣，所以必須一次又一次游到水面上。因為這樣，海豚一次只讓一側的大腦休息，另一側保持清醒，而且常常睜著一隻眼睛。
【D 馬】馬可以站著小睡片刻，睡得很淺。牠們的腿可以鎖定在固定位置，所以不會跌倒。不過，要進入最深層的睡眠，馬就必須躺下。因為馬會被其他動物獵捕，所以只有在覺得安全時才會躺下。
【E 蝙蝠】許多蝙蝠倒掛在高處睡覺。蝙蝠的腳趾一旦鎖住，自己的體重就能讓牠穩穩掛在那裡。這樣一來，蝙蝠可以休息好幾個小時，卻不必耗費太多能量。
【F 軍艦鳥】軍艦鳥是一種海鳥，可以在海上連續飛好幾個星期都不降落。科學家發現這些鳥可以在空中睡覺，有時一側大腦睡著、另一側醒著。飛行時，牠們一天睡不到一小時；但在陸地上，牠們一天會睡超過十二個小時。
